_comment: Repos to poll for new commits. Each entry watches `branch` under `path` (or the whole repo if path is omitted). A new commit drafts a post into pending-posts/ for approval; nothing publishes on its own. The GitHub Actions cron schedule controls how often this runs, not a value in here.
_captionTemplate: Only used as a fallback when GEMINI_API_KEY is missing or the call fails. Normally the post is written from the commit. {url} is left empty for private repos, since readers can't open those links.
